summary: Fixed ai-observer data loss issues with JSON validation, backup reliability, and local persistence. Backfilled 5 missing sessions. Verified mempalace storage working correctly.
tasks: Added jq validation to catch invalid JSON from Q
Implemented fallback JSON generation with jq
Fixed backup script to never fail on duplicates (unique timestamp IDs)
Created backfill-sessions.sh to recover 5 missing sessions
Verified all fixes with syntax checks and test commands
decisions: Use jq for JSON validation instead of trusting Q output
Always save local copy even if mempalace upload succeeds
Append timestamp to backup source_file to prevent duplicate failures
Manual backfill needed for sessions that failed before fixes
problems: Q returned invalid JSON causing storage failures
Backup failed on duplicates with no retry
No local persistence meant data loss risk
5 sessions from April 24 missing from mempalace
learnings: Never trust LLM JSON output without validation
Backup systems must never fail - use unique IDs
Local persistence is critical safety net
Cross-verification reveals gaps between recording and storage
